GizClaw 让设备通过 WebRTC 接入边缘节点，使用 MHS v0 协议: GizClaw connects devices to edge nodes over WebRTC. Agents use MHS v0 to invoke device capabilities from the server, which can also run agents.
让 Agent 从边缘节点: Let agents connect from the edge
设备通过 WebRTC 接入 GizClaw 的边缘节点。Agent 使用 MH: Devices connect to GizClaw edge nodes over WebRTC. Agents invoke device capabilities from the server through MHS v0. GizClaw also provides an Agent Runtime for device-facing agents.
GizClaw 概念拓扑：设备通过 WebRTC 连接边缘 AP；Agent 通: GizClaw concept topology: devices connect to edge APs over WebRTC. Agents invoke device capabilities from edge runtime nodes through MHS v0. Runtime nodes can host Agent Runtime and connect to LiveKit SFU. Remote Workspace connections to other agent services are planned. Node positions do not represent live network coverage.
架构示意 · 非现网覆盖: Architecture concept · Not live network coverage
Remote Workspace → 其他 Agent 服务 · 规划中: Remote Workspace → Other Agent Services · Planning
架构示意 · 节点位置与线路不代表现网覆盖或实际路由: Architecture concept · Node positions and lines do not represent live coverage or routing
设备侧使用 GizOS H2Peer 建立 WebRTC 连接。DataChan: The device side uses GizOS H2Peer to establish a WebRTC connection. DataChannel carries control and data messages, RTP carries real-time media; GizClaw runs the MHS v0 device interaction protocol on the connection.
区域 AP 接收设备连接，并将流量转发到对应的运行节点。设备不需要向 Agent: Regional APs accept device connections and forward traffic to the relevant runtime node. Devices do not need to expose a public endpoint to agents.
运行节点处理设备身份与授权，运行 Agent，并通过 MHS v0 从服务端调用: Runtime nodes handle device identity and authorization, run agents and invoke device capabilities through MHS v0.
LiveKit 是 system-sfu Workspace 的连接器，用于好友: LiveKit is a connector for system-sfu Workspace for friends to talk to your team.
Remote Workspace 接入其他 Agent 服务是规划中的扩展路径。: Connecting Remote Workspace to other Agent services is a planned extension. Latency, availability and deployment regions depend on network and environment; this page makes no fixed end-to-end millisecond SLA claim.

GizOS：从 PAL、Runtime 到 H2Loader，构建跨芯片、跨平台: GizOS: a cross-chip, cross-platform foundation for firmware and apps, from PAL and Runtime to H2Loader.
GizOS 用 PAL 隔离芯片和外设细节。AI 可以先在桌面或 WebAsse: GizOS uses PAL to isolate chip and peripheral details. AI can develop, run and test app logic on desktop or WebAssembly first, then bring the same app to an embedded target for validation on real hardware.
GizOS 架构：App、Runtime、PAL、BSP、硬件: GizOS architecture: App, Runtime, PAL, BSP and hardware
AI 可以围绕稳定的 Runtime 接口写 App，用桌面和 Web 目标快速: AI can write apps against stable Runtime interfaces and quickly test interaction and state logic on desktop and Web targets. After iteration, BSP and platform implementations connect real peripherals, and the target builds the relevant image. Hardware behavior still requires tests on physical devices.
管理 Loader 和 App 两种镜像：校验更新包、发送到设备，再由设备完成安: Manage both Loader and App images: verify the update package, send it to the device, and then the device completes the installation, startup, switchover, or rollback. This Batch Flashing tool uses the H2Loader Web SDK.
设备侧 WebRTC 实现。它通过 PAL 获取网络和加密能力，处理连接、Dat: Device-side WebRTC implementation. It uses PAL for networking and cryptography, handles connections, DataChannel messages and RTP media. Products provide their own signaling and audio-device integration.
在设备上提交并运行 Lua 程序。Lua 可以接收 Runtime 事件，调用注: Submit and run Lua programs on the device. Lua can receive Runtime events and call registered device capabilities, making it suitable for in-product interactions.
提供 LVGL 界面、音频等可复用模块，仓库中的项目和示例展示了怎样把这些模块接: Provides reusable modules such as LVGL interface, audio, etc. Projects and examples in the repository show how to connect these modules to specific applications.
Bazel 配置按目标选择依赖和产物。仓库列出的目标如下；具体外设能否使用，仍取: Bazel selects dependencies and outputs by target. The repository lists the targets below; peripheral availability depends on each board implementation.
平台配置代表仓库中的构建目标；具体外设能力和产品验收仍以对应 board、tar: Platform configurations represent build targets in the repository. Peripheral capabilities and product acceptance depend on the relevant board, target and verification results.

CoreHTTP、CoreMQTT 通过网络、时间和内存 PAL 接口工作；li: CoreHTTP and CoreMQTT use PAL interfaces for networking, time and memory; libco provides portable cooperative task support. App code does not need to call each chip vendor’s HTTP, MQTT or task SDK directly.
在已建立的 BLE 连接上，把 GATT 收发变成可靠、有序的字节流，支持 re: Over an established BLE connection, BLE iKCP turns GATT send and receive into a reliable, ordered byte stream with read, write, flush and close. The product defines device discovery, connection and reconnection policy.
GizOS 维护的可移植 WebRTC 核心，通过 PAL 接入网络、加密和任务: A portable WebRTC core maintained by GizOS. Through PAL it uses networking, cryptography and task capabilities to handle DataChannel messages and RTP media. Products supply signaling, codecs and audio-device integration.
PAL 为设备通信与脚本运行提供稳定的底层接口。GizClaw 的 MHS v0: PAL provides stable low-level interfaces for device communication and script execution. GizClaw MHS v0 is designed for agent-device interaction; Lua Runtime lets in-product programs use device events and capabilities. Protocol integration on a given target depends on its version and verification results.

在 PAL 之上，Runtime 组织组件映射、输入处理、事件与状态。App 使: Above PAL, Runtime organizes component mapping, input processing, events and state. Apps use stable runtime interfaces without knowing the underlying chip or board.
PAL 定义统一的系统、网络与设备能力接口。具体实现留在平台侧，Runtime: PAL defines unified system, network and device capability interfaces. Implementations stay on the platform side; Runtime and Apps remain portable above them.

PAL 是 Platform Abstraction Layer（平台抽象层），: PAL means Platform Abstraction Layer. Its unified interfaces isolate differences in chip SDKs, operating systems and peripherals, keeping Runtime and Apps portable.
